name: Cross Realms
source:
Embark on the adventure of a 19-year-old college newcomer whose life takes an unexpected twist on the very first day at his new university. In a bewildering turn of events, you and your group of friends are transported to the Nine Realms, captivating worlds where one's status is determined by their Qi cultivation. The stronger you become, the more influence you wield over others.

As you journey through these nine realms, you forge both friendships and adversaries, gradually assembling a harem while unraveling the mystery behind your parents' disappearance. Yet, the most pressing questions remain: "Why are you here?" and "Who send you here". 

The answer are yours to find.

[From [url=https://duskduck.itch.io/cross-realms]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
踏上一名19岁大学新人的冒险之旅，他的生活在新大学的第一天就发生了意想不到的转折。在令人眼花缭乱的事件中，你和你的一群朋友被传送到九界，在这个迷人的世界里，一个人的地位取决于他们的气修。你变得越强大，你对他人的影响力就越大。

当你穿越这九个领域时，你会结交朋友和敌人，逐渐组建后宫，同时揭开父母失踪背后的谜团。然而，最紧迫的问题仍然是：“你为什么在这里？”和“谁派你来这里的”。

答案就由你来寻找。

[来自[url=https://duskduck.itch.io/cross-realms]Itch.io[/url]]
